# on.pull_request.paths of the workflow must list the same patterns in the same order

# every file a job of the workflow executes or reads is listed: a missing one skips the
# checks on a change that alters them

# [package.metadata.cargo-machete]) and every .rs file under it as a use of a dependency
# (tests/, benches/, examples/, fuzz/fuzz_targets/)
**/Cargo.toml
**/*.rs
